basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old gamer from Austin, Texas, who spends most evenings exploring the world of Azeroth. I work as a software developer by day and enjoy delving into dungeons and raiding in World of Warcraft by night. I'm currently single and often team up with online friends for gaming sessions. I'm not a fan of early mornings, so you’ll usually find me online late into the night. I enjoy tech discussions and have a side interest in optimizing Android devices, which led me to the SD Maid subreddit.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a strong understanding of MMORPGs, acquired through years of gaming experience and participation in online communities. I also have a solid foundation in software development, with a degree in Computer Science. I often apply this knowledge when troubleshooting tech issues or discussing game mechanics.
